name: Footer banner
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site pre-footer call-to-action card (Webflow section-container > card-based-section img-card-section): a Vivid Pink card on the DS centre Splash background (Darker Pink hooks) with a centred white heading and a white Get started free button, directly above the Footer on a white section. An optional white paragraph sits between the heading and the button (the Enterprise variant), and an optional scroll-in reveal reproduces the fade-up used on the Compare page. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Webflow section Footer banner, restyled as a Vivid Pink card; geometry matched to the live ahaslides.com at 1440px, 768px and 375px

Card is a 1280px-wide, 16px-radius Vivid Pink surface with the DS centre Splash background (Darker Pink hooks, no gradient, no image file to host) and a centred white heading (40px, 32px at 991px and below)
Button is white with Vivid Pink text; hover and press darken the text, keyboard focus shows a white ring over a Vivid Pink gap
Heading, optional paragraph and button copy and link are per-page content
Optional --reveal modifier fades the card in and lifts the heading when it scrolls into view; reduced motion shows it at rest
